title: CLO Techniques Workshop - Production of Intercolor Ribbing

summary: # CLO Techniques Workshop - Production of Intercolor Ribbing ## Introduction Hello everyone! In this workshop, I will show you how to create a colored pattern using specific techniques. ## Pattern Material Selection First, find the pattern material in the window of the picture. Then, apply it to the plate on the collar. ## Accessing the Pattern Attributes Locate the pattern of the pattern material in the attribute container. ## Using Photoshop for Color Construction 1. Use Photoshop (PS) to open the pattern. 2. Draw the color construction effect. - The purple RGB value should match the dark purple in the close-up. 3. Fill in the base color. ## Layer Management Next, build a new layer to fill in the white. You can use the marker tool to assist in this process. ## Saving Your Work After completing the above steps, save your work. This will display the effect of the saved pattern. ## Editing the Pattern In the close-up view, replace the original pattern. You can use the edit pattern tool to adjust the position of the pattern as needed. ## Three-Dimensional Pattern Construction If you need to perform a three-dimensional construction of the pattern, we need to create a corresponding call pattern in Photoshop. 1. Select a layer. 2. Fill it in with black. 3. Copy the white layer. 4. Merge the layers. ## Applying High-Fiber Blur Add a layer to apply a high-fiber blur. - This is the high-fiber blur effect. - Repeat the application to ensure consistency. ## Finalizing the Pattern 1. Save your work after applying the high-fiber blur. 2. Once saved, apply this call pattern. 3. Adjust the call degree to 1 and set the particle diameter to 1. ## Rendering the Final Effect Turn on the render feature to view the effect. - As you can see, the value will be converted to 1:1. - You can observe the result here. ## Conclusion Then, you can replicate the same steps to achieve your desired pattern.
